therapeutic_hypothesis.compound: Endo-HDR brachytherapy vs IMRT with capecitabine
therapeutic_hypothesis.proposed_mechanism: high-dose radiation therapy with or without radiosensitizing chemotherapy
therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: tumor cell death and DNA damage

results.effect_size: Endo-HDR: 2/5 patients achieved pCR vs IMRT+capecitabine: 0/4 patients achieved pCR
subgroup_findings: Endo-HDR showed higher pathologic complete response rate (40% vs 0%)
Quality of life scores varied between arms with Endo-HDR showing better post-operative scores
results.dose_information: Endo-HDR: 6.5 Gy daily x 4 days (total 26 Gy); IMRT with capecitabine 825mg/m2 BID; FOLFOX6 with oxaliplatin 85 mg/m², leucovorin 400mg/m², 5FU 2400 mg/m²

context.comparator: IMRT with capecitabine vs Endo-HDR brachytherapy
